title: Ok as a duvet cover but major failing as a protector for use under a duvet cover
text: Ok as a duvet cover but major failing as a protector for use under a duvet cover. I was disappointed by this product.  I regularly use a duvet cover on my down comforter and one thing that has always been kind of a pain is all the feathers coming out when you take the cover off to wash it. So I got this protector largely to keep the comforter covered when I take the duvet on and off and also to further protect the comforter itself from getting dirty. But unfortunately, they didn't include any ties or way to attach this cover to your duvet.  Almost all duvets now come with something in the corners of the inside, usually ties or a loop or a button and you use that to connect to the loops on the comforter for a secure fit (so it doesn't move around on you). This has those for the comforter itself but if you want to put it in something else you are SOL, in fact it's worse than a plan comforter because this is kind a shiny-slippery fabric and it was very hard t get into the duvet cover evenly and get to stay there. That definitely does NOT make the process easier which was my purpose in buying it.  So beware if that is your intention too. I am going to buy some clips that I used to have for duvets before everyone started putting the loops on and that may help but it's annoying to have to do that.
